messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — release cutoff in ~6h for v1.4.0. Please make sure CI is green and any version-bump PRs have changelog entries. I will freeze main at 18:00 PT. Ping me if you need an exception. @ash @priya

ash: Seeing a flaky failure in integration: test_chunked_streaming.test_timeout keeps failing on macos-latest. I pushed a debug run to my branch.

ash: failing snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: stream did not produce data for 30s
tests/integration/test_chunked_streaming.py:48
---------------------------- Captured stdout ----------------------------
starting stream with conn_id=abc123
```

priya: Thanks for the ping. My release PR needs a tiny version bump and a changelog line (PR #482). I added a draft entry but not merged until CI is green. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/482

deploy-bot: CI summary for main @1718723600 -> unit-tests: passed, lint: passed, integration-tests: 9/12 failed (see logs), build: passed. Rerun count available. https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1257

jake: I can take the flaky. First guess: race on stream close under slow network. I'll try repro with env SIMULATE_PACKET_DELAY=1.

qa: I reproduced locally on Linux with the same timeout using `pytest -k chunked_streaming -vv`. Adding a small increase to the per-chunk timeout fixed it locally. We should avoid any forced merges.

maria: Plan: do a green-sweep pass — folks, if your PRs are blocked by this flaky, either (1) mark with `ci/skip-integration` for now and we’ll cherry-pick the version bump after green sweep, or (2) request a re-run after triage. No forced merges without at least one eng-review + qa signoff.

ash: Doing a diagnostic rerun now. Command I used:
```bash
pytest tests/integration/test_chunked_streaming.py::test_timeout -q -k timeout --maxfail=1
# or to re-run failed, use: pytest --lf
```

devx-bot: Reminder: release cutoff is at 18:00 PT (1718726400). Please update the release board and tag PRs needing post-freeze attention.

priya: Changelog entry updated and linked in PR #482. If CI is green after the sweep I can merge and cut the tag.

jake: Reran integration matrix with SIMULATE_PACKET_DELAY=1 and got 11/12 passing, one still flaky. I opened a tiny fix PR to increase the timeout with a TODO to revisit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/489

qa: Verified PR #489 locally. Should be safe.

maria: OK — priority order: 1) triage flaky and rerun 2) merge version bump PRs with changelog 3) tag and cut RC. If anything blocks the cutoff, call it out immediately here.

ash: merging debug branch to unblock CI sweep, then will revert/cherry-pick as needed.

priya: All set from my side once CI passes.

jake: FYI I added an integration test skip label to the flaky test for the Windows job only — lower blast radius.

maria: Thanks all. Will monitor CI and announce freeze at 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled a full CI rerun at 1718724800. Results will post here when complete.

ash: thanks — ping me if rerun fails again and I'll investigate next steps. :eyes:
